cards.audioText: When do pilots normally perform a flight control check?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员通常在什么时候进行飞行操纵检查？
cards.referenceText: Pilots normally perform the required flight-control check during ground preparation or taxi before takeoff, at the point specified by the checklist and SOP. It is done only when the area is clear and control movement will not create a hazard. A further check may be required after maintenance or an abnormal indication, but the approved procedure determines its scope.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员通常在起飞前的地面准备或滑行期间，于检查单和 SOP 规定的节点完成飞行操纵检查。只有在周围区域安全、操纵面运动不会造成危险时才实施。维修后或出现异常指示后可能需要进一步检查，但检查范围由批准程序规定。

cards.audioText: How do the pilot flying and pilot monitoring normally share duties during a flight control check?
cards.audioTextZh: 进行飞行操纵检查时，操纵飞行员与监控飞行员通常如何分工？
cards.referenceText: A suitable arrangement would have one pilot move the controls through the approved sequence while the other confirms the indications, direction and required system response. Both pilots monitor the surrounding area, and the pilot performing the check announces each movement or result as required. Any restriction or disagreement stops the check and is handled through the applicable procedure before departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 一个合适的分工是：一名飞行员按照批准顺序移动操纵装置，另一名飞行员确认指示、方向和规定的系统响应。两名飞行员都要监控周围区域，实施检查的飞行员按要求宣布每项动作或结果。任何卡阻或不一致都会使检查停止，并在离场前按照适用程序处理。
